description: Convert CSS custom properties into W3C design tokens (DTCG) JSON. Pass `css` (a :root block, a whole stylesheet, or a Tailwind v4 @theme block). Each variable is typed from its value and name (colour, dimension in px or rem, duration, number, fontFamily, fontWeight, cubicBezier, shadow), grouped by type (color, spacing, radius, font-size, duration, and so on), and a var(--other) value becomes a {group.name} alias. The original CSS name and any dark value (from prefers-color-scheme: dark or a .dark or data-theme=dark selector) are kept in $extensions so dtcg_to_css can round-trip them. Variables that cannot be typed (calc(), clamp(), percentages, gradients, compound values, references to undefined variables) are listed with the reason instead of being guessed.

css.description: CSS with custom properties. Free up to 100,000 characters; Pro up to 2,000,000.

name: css_to_dtcg
title: CSS to design tokens
